content: Decoupling LLM enrichment from ingestion: expensive/slow/rate-limited LLM calls should not sit inline in the ingestion path — bolting them on causes backpressure that stalls fast ingestion. Standard pattern is a separate enrichment stage/worker that reads already-persisted raw/scored items and writes enrichment results keyed by a stable content hash or item ID, so enrichment is cache-checked (skip if already enriched) and independently retryable without re-touching ingestion. SHA256-based caching keyed on content is a common technique to guarantee an item is never sent to the LLM twice. Corroborated across Kafka-pipeline architecture write-ups and RAG/enrichment pipeline literature.
